structure.layout: single-column centered tool landing page: minimal header, hero, upload drop zone, how-it-works strip, promo card, reference table, CTA cards, FAQ accordion, multilingual footer

aesthetics.typography: Fraunces (serif, italic for 'Word' in H1, section headings, card/FAQ titles); JetBrains Mono (H1 'Markdown', eyebrow, file chips, code cells, meta notes); Hanken Grotesk (body, subhead, links, buttons)
aesthetics.typeScale: Large display H1 72px mixing serif italic, sans and mono; H2 30px serif; card titles 18-20px serif; body 16-18px; meta/mono 11-14px with wide letter-spaced uppercase eyebrow

notes: Warm off-white paper background with a faint dotted grid texture at the top. Distinctive three-typeface H1 that literally performs the conversion: 'Word' in italic Fraunces serif, 'to' in muted sans, 'Markdown' in JetBrains Mono. Olive (#646a00) and pale lime chip fills are the only brand color; the .docx → .md chip pair acts as a small diagram. Drop zone uses dashed 2px border with a lime circular icon. Privacy messaging ('never uploaded') repeated in hero, drop zone and footer. Dark navy book-promo card is the single high-contrast block. Footer offers 21 languages.
